name: iact_gampeg_ctao_alpha
label: gamma Peg (0.35 mas, B2 IV) on the CTAO-North alpha array (4 LSTs + 9 MSTs, 78 baselines to 560 m): diameter and limb darkening past the first null, Stage I against Stage II
notes: The MST pairs carry the star through its first null (300 m) into the second lobe, where the limb darkening is; Luce et al.: ~1 % on theta_UD for B < 4 and ~10 % on u for B < 1.2 in 2.5 h with 4 LSTs + 9 MSTs.
Stage II (dedicated photodetectors, 2 GHz, 1 nm x 10 channels) is 9.6x Stage I per pair in this model: the analog S/N does not depend on the filter width.
